intro: Palau has about 340 islands, including the famous mushroom-shaped Rock Islands.

chapters.title: Rock Islands
text: The Rock Islands are hundreds of small limestone islands covered in forest, a World Heritage site. Jellyfish Lake is home to millions of golden jellyfish that lost most of their sting.

chapters.title: Reefs
text: Palau's reefs, walls and blue holes make it one of the world's top diving places.

keyTerms.meaning: A lake connected to the sea underground.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Palau's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
